entries.x1_r34: NO-ERROR-FOUND on numerics: N=1e6 L=120 bars re-derived from fit.json and bar_v3 returns them (9.235/9.034/9.456/9.053); control counts reproduce RESULTS (9/9 cells at L=120/240/400, 1/9 at L=31, 3/9 free). FOUND-ERROR (substantive framing): Q5 'FIRED, 8-11 SE' compares the v3 pmax (a per-length z-score, sd ~ n^-1/2 per round32/I2 adjudicate.py:111) with R32 I3's raw legacy EN quadgram statistic (round32/I3 RESULTS:71); z-normalising adds about +0.5 to the exponent, so the like-for-like prediction is about -0.05 and the observed -0.105/-0.136 are 1.4/2.1 combined SE from it. The trigger was a false alarm on a mis-specified comparator, not evidence of a non-Gumbel tail. FOUND-ERROR (minor): 'Gumbel conservative' holds at L=31-240 (observed max below the predicted median in 13 of 16 cells; P(model max<=obs) 0.000-0.07 in the 40k cells) but at L=400 the observed max meets or exceeds the predicted median in 3 of 4 cells. 'B3 bars not lenient' is too strong: at N=202,142 L=120 B3's 8.546/8.373 sit 0.08/0.08 (lp2) and 0.28/0.09 (register) below this lane's bars (rerun_b3_bars.json).

entries.x1_r34: FOUND-ERROR (substantive) against I2 RESULTS 'Key measurement finding'. The argument 'real U[:40] has zero doublets (TRUE: also zero in U[:120]) so the true-key head decode is skip-free' is wrong for the output-side filter: a key skip happens when the CANDIDATE cipher rune equals the previous one and is invisible in the emitted ciphertext. In 600 R32-style plants per cell, P(no skip inside m=18..24) is 0.49-0.63 and is 0.54-0.64 even among plants whose cipher head contains no doublet (rerun_i2_skipfree.json). So R32-B1's 0.47 NOVOWEL prefilter power is NOT a planting artefact: re-run on R32's own logic gives 0.555-0.62 (m=18/24, q0.999) against R32's stored 0.51-0.62. NO-ERROR-FOUND against round32/B1-bash-random RESULTS and the R32-B1 row (left unchanged). The honest R34-I2 reach for B1/B2 is the with-skip column (about 0.66 NOVOWEL, 0.71 EN_MODERN at FPR 1e-3, i.e. NOVOWEL up from about 0.47-0.6, EN_MODERN not improved), not 0.998.
